x: In June 2026 (27 Jun) Netra AEW&C's Final Operational Clearance (FOC) was handed to the Indian Air Force; option C's 'full operational clearance' refers to this FOC. Netra is a DRDO-CABS airborne early-warning system for the IAF, not a Navy test or a frigate.
INS Aridhaman (S4), the third Arihant-class SSBN (about 7,000 t, 8 VLS), was commissioned at Visakhapatnam on 3 April 2026. April 2024 was INS Arighaat (S3).
Netra AEW&C (DRDO-CABS, AESA radar on Embraer EMB-145) received Final Operational Clearance, handed to the IAF on 27 June 2026.
Mahendragiri, the 7th Project 17A (Nilgiri-class) frigate and the 6th to be commissioned, joined the Eastern Fleet at Visakhapatnam on 18 July 2026.

The notes place a DRDO test range near Kurnool (21 May 2026) as part of AP's defence ecosystem; Visakhapatnam hosts the Eastern Naval Command, NSTL and HSL, and Sri Sathya Sai district has BEL Palasamudram and the ADA complex.
